lines.name: David
lines.en: Good afternoon! How can I help you?

lines.name: Hyunju
lines.en: I'd like to exchange Korean won for Thai baht.
lines.ko: 한국 원화를 태국 바트로 환전하고 싶어요.

lines.name: David
lines.en: Sure! Korean won to Thai baht. How much would you like to exchange?

lines.name: Hyunju
lines.en: I'd like to exchange five hundred thousand won.

lines.name: David
lines.en: Five hundred thousand won. OK! May I see your ID, please?
lines.ko: 50만 원이요. 알겠습니다! 신분증 좀 보여 주시겠어요?

lines.name: David
lines.en: Thank you. Would you like large bills or small bills?
lines.ko: 감사합니다. 큰 단위 지폐로 드릴까요, 작은 단위로 드릴까요?

lines.name: Hyunju
lines.en: I'd like half in small bills, please.

lines.name: David
lines.en: Sure! Half in large bills and half in small bills. Are you traveling to Thailand?
lines.ko: 네! 절반은 큰 단위, 절반은 작은 단위로요. 태국 여행 가세요?

lines.name: Hyunju
lines.en: Yes, I'm going to Thailand on vacation.

lines.name: David
lines.en: How nice! When are you leaving?

lines.name: David
lines.en: December! That's a great time to visit. Here's your baht and the receipt. Is there anything else I can help you with?
lines.ko: 12월이요! 여행하기 딱 좋은 때죠. 바트랑 영수증 여기 있습니다. 더 도와드릴 게 있을까요?

lines.name: David
lines.en: OK! Have a wonderful trip to Thailand, and enjoy the night markets!
lines.ko: 알겠습니다! 태국 여행 즐겁게 다녀오시고, 야시장도 실컷 즐기세요!
